```{r forgModTab, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, error=FALSE, echo=FALSE, out.width='100%', tab.cap="All foraging model candidate model terms for predicting the probability that Eastern Reef Egrets would be on the island or reef using a generalised linear mixed model. Results ranked by AIC values."}

forgModTab<-readRDS("../../src_outputs/candidateForgMods.rds")%>%
  mutate(AIC = round(AIC, 2),
         AICdelta = round(AICdelta,  2))%>%
  remove_rownames()
